d: Android to PS Vita port of Raging Thunder
ld: Unofficial port of Raging Thunder (Polarbit, Android) to the PS Vita, running the original ARM game library through a native loader (TheFloW's so-loader + FalsoJNI) with rendering via vitaGL.
req:
- HENkaku / Enso	Any recent firmware with homebrew support
- kubridge.skprx	Required, loaded in taiHEN config (*KERNEL)
- libshacccg.suprx	Required at ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx (via ShaRKBR33D)
